correctness.rationale: For W=(01)^a0(01)^b0(01)^c (a,b,c>=1), partition its distinct contiguous factors by the number 0,1,2 of the marked 00 defects. No-defect factors are alternating from the maximum-length run T=max(A,B,C), contributing q_T(l). Single-defect factors are bijective with offset pairs in rectangles A×B and B×C, except identical factors in their intersection min(A,B)×min(B,C), giving diagonal H terms by inclusion-exclusion. Two-defect factors have fixed interdefect corridor length B+2 and extension rectangle A×C. This proves every-length formula and summed total 2T-1+AB+BC-min(A,B)min(B,C)+AC. Direct independent enumeration verified all lengths for all 343 triples 1<=a,b,c<=7. Finite checks only corroborate exact counting bijections.
residual_risks: The independent finite checks are bounded and do not themselves establish infinite quantifiers.

A three-parameter all-length exact spectrum and total answer may serve repetitive-string enumeration/attractor benchmarks rather than an arbitrary tiny-instance count.
